impurity_rule_scope_valid.name: impurity_rule_scope_valid
impurity_rule_scope_valid.value: "impurity_rule"."spec_id" IS NULL OR "impurity_rule"."category_id" IS NOT NULL

impurity_rule_period_valid.name: impurity_rule_period_valid
impurity_rule_period_valid.value: "impurity_rule"."effective_to" IS NULL OR "impurity_rule"."effective_from" IS NULL OR "impurity_rule"."effective_to" >= "impurity_rule"."effective_from"

term_mapping_scope_source.name: term_mapping_scope_source
term_mapping_scope_source.value: ("term_mapping"."scope" = 'global' AND "term_mapping"."source_id" IS NULL) OR ("term_mapping"."scope" = 'source' AND "term_mapping"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)

region_mapping_scope_source.name: region_mapping_scope_source
region_mapping_scope_source.value: ("region_mapping"."scope" = 'global' AND "region_mapping"."source_id" IS NULL) OR ("region_mapping"."scope" = 'source' AND "region_mapping"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)

price_observation_raw_range.name: price_observation_raw_range
price_observation_raw_range.value: "price_observation"."raw_value_low" IS NULL OR "price_observation"."raw_value_high" IS NULL OR "price_observation"."raw_value_low" <= "price_observation"."raw_value_high"

price_observation_norm_range.name: price_observation_norm_range
price_observation_norm_range.value: "price_observation"."norm_value_low" IS NULL OR "price_observation"."norm_value_high" IS NULL OR "price_observation"."norm_value_low" <= "price_observation"."norm_value_high"

price_observation_validated_completeness.name: price_observation_validated_completeness
price_observation_validated_completeness.value:
"price_observation"."validation_status" <> 'validated' OR (
        "price_observation"."category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "price_observation"."spec_id" IS NOT NULL AND "price_observation"."region_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "price_observation"."price_type" IS NOT NULL AND "price_observation"."quote_date" IS NOT NULL
        AND "price_observation"."norm_value_low" IS NOT NULL AND "price_observation"."norm_value_high" IS NOT NULL AND "price_observation"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

series_point_high_low.name: series_point_high_low
series_point_high_low.value: "series_point"."high_price" IS NULL OR "series_point"."low_price" IS NULL OR "series_point"."high_price" >= "series_point"."low_price"
